question: What will be the amount after 1 year if ₹9,900 is invested at 20% compound interest per annum, compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹9,900

Rate (r) = 20% per annum

Compounding frequency = Half-yearly

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/(100 × n))ⁿ×t

Where:

A = Amount

P = Principal

r = Rate of interest

n = Number of times interest is compounded in a year

t = Time in years

**Calculation:**

n = 2 (compounded half-yearly)

A = 9,900(1 + 20/(100 × 2))²×¹

⇒ A = 9,900(1 + 20/200)²

⇒ A = 9,900(1 + 0.1)²

⇒ A = 9,900(1.1)²

⇒ A = 9,900 × 1.21

⇒ A = ₹11,979

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
